claim_ceiling: finite Manifold-tower L12 scratch diagnostic only. Discovers inequality regions, connected components, cell membership, and equivalence classes from observable readouts on a finite probe grid. No terrain labels, hidden terrain classes, hand-written region labels, or universal equivalence are admitted.
source_target: Manifold-tower L12: region discovery from observables (NO terrain labels).

object_under_test.probe_set: finite 10 x 12 probe grid P = {(x,y)} with 4-neighbor adjacency A4
object_under_test.observable_readout: O(p) = (o0(p), o1(p), o2(p)) in integer readout space; all region structure is recomputed from these values
object_under_test.equivalence_relation: observable_threshold_component_equivalence_v0: p equiv_{O,tau,A4} q iff sigma_tau(O(p)) = sigma_tau(O(q)) and p,q are connected by an A4 path whose every cell has that same threshold signature
object_under_test.quotient: P / equiv_{O,tau,A4}; each quotient class is one discovered connected component

hypotheses_under_test: H_regions: inequality signatures induced by observable values partition the finite probe set into non-universal inequality regions.
H_components: same-signature 4-connected components form the discovered region classes and cover every probe cell exactly once.
H_membership: cell membership is derived from observable threshold signatures plus adjacency, not from terrain labels.
H_label_shuffle: shuffling display labels for signatures leaves the structural quotient invariant.
H_value_change: changing observable values, without editing any label or adjacency structure, moves region boundaries and changes quotient classes.
controls_that_must_fire: label_shuffle_control: permute only display names attached to threshold signatures; the structure hash and cell memberships must remain invariant.
value_change_control: add a real data perturbation to observable o0 on a finite cell mask; the threshold memberships, boundary edges, and component count must change.
nonuniversal_relation_control: the named threshold-component equivalence must produce more than one class and more than one threshold signature.

engines.exact: numpy/stdlib exact integer reference leg using explicit BFS over same-signature 4-neighbor cells
engines.jax: JAX x64 leg using vectorized thresholding plus fixed-point min-label propagation for connected components
